CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Converted from a price-rule-stamped writable Date to a Roll-Up Summary: MAX of QuoteLineItem.Ruby__SubscriptionEndDate__c across lines where ELV_Include_in_Exit_ARR__c = true. Summarizes the Nue subscription end date rather than ELV_End_Date__c because that field is a cross-object formula and is not roll-up eligible; on all 76 Exit-ARR lines in Build the two agree exactly, and Ruby__SubscriptionEndDate__c is populated on every flagged line. The Exit-ARR filter also excludes a bad 3276-08-09 end date present on unflagged lines.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Latest subscription end date across the quote lines included in Exit ARR.
CustomField.label: Max End Date
